findings.quote: A January 1 Flying Blue economy award summary lists 23,000 points plus 200,300 TWD minor-unit fees, but it starts at TPE, not SFO, and has only a date—not a timed itinerary.
findings.expected: The exact TPE-BKK economy summary has program.state=value, program.value=qantas, source_field=Source in both WorkspaceEvidence and source.view. Its 23000 points belong to Qantas, not Flying Blue. January 1, endpoints and 200300 TWD minor units are otherwise correct. Program identity determines which miles/program can be used and is material even for an incomplete lead.
